entry.content: You can now use built-in error monitoring in Cloudflare Workers to group production failures and send stack traces, logs, traces, and application context directly to a coding agent to investigate further and open a pull request.

entry.title: Simplifying domains for people and agents
entry.content: Cloudflare Registrar’s new search delivers fast, transparent results across 420+ extensions using Workers, Durable Objects, and WebSockets. Its expanded API and cf CLI also let agents search, register, and transfer domains.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402
entry.content: Cloudflare’s AI Gateway, Ceramic.ai, Stocktwits, and more are using the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway today to charge agents for access to tokens, APIs, and MCP tools. U.S.-based sellers can now apply for access to the closed beta.

entry.title: Pay Per Use: when AI uses your work, you should get paid
entry.content: Pay Per Use is now in beta. AI companies report when they use publishers’ content, and Cloudflare handles billing, payouts, and reporting, so our customers are paid according to use.

entry.title: Identify AI model overuse with User Insights
